prompt: Implement the Forth interpreter in src/lib.rs: `Forth::new`, `Forth::eval` and `Forth::stack`. The module documentation at the top of src/lib.rs is the specification; follow all of it, including the rules for user-defined words and for what happens on errors. Programs may build long chains of definitions on top of each other (for example, redefining a word in terms of its previous meaning dozens of times), so the time and memory needed to define a word must be proportional to the length of its definition, not to what it would expand to. Keep the public API (`Forth`, `Value`, `Error`) as declared. Run the tests with `cargo test --offline`; tests/basics.rs must pass, and you should add tests for the rest of the spec.
